description: Find keys and/or values in a JSON file, below a place (default) or in each ancestor level above it (up: true, nearest first). key = exact key name; value = exact JSON value (same type: 1 is not "1"); give both to match key and value together; contains: true = key and string values match by substring. One line per hit: FILE#/POINTER TYPE SIZE; "[no match]" if none. No regular expressions. Example: {"path": "cfg.json", "key": "next"}. Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/json_search.json.

path.description: FILE#/POINTER in one string, e.g. cfg.json#/states/think/next; FILE alone (or FILE#) = the whole document; FILE#/ is the key named "" (RFC 6901). Relative files start at your workspace.

contains.description: true = substring match for key and string values (case-sensitive)

up.description: true = search the ancestors' own keys, nearest level first, instead of everything below

limit.description: at most this many hits (default: env AOS_JSON_MAX_ITEMS, else 200)
